device.model: HD-XS2 (Globo) / Blue XS65 (Opticum): Polish retail build
device.soc: ALi M3503 (the bootloader chunk's version "M3503---0.1.0"; the archive names the package M3511; the main code is the SDK's "M3602 HD STB" / "S3602 HD STB" platform build with the chip's internal NIM_S3503 demodulator driver)

simulator.note: Boots as the M3503 family (chips/m3503.py), completes the SEE's SHA-256 verification of the application on the crypto engine (crypto_engine.py) and draws its Polish first-install wizard "Wybierz język" (Polski, Niemiecki, Angielski) by ~100 M instructions (~241 GE commands), with the front panel showing " ON ", " on ", "Strt".

desc: The 1.4.0 Polish retail update (140_M3511-RETAIL_PL.abs) for the Opticum Blue XS65 / Globo HD-XS2 satellite receiver, succeeding the 1.3.5 Reta_pol build on the same SDK4.0fa.13.8_20150326 platform.
The archive and file name identify the chip package as M3511 (an M3503-family satellite SoC whose bootloader chunk version is "M3503---0.1.0" and whose chip ID is 0x3503).
